title: Sieve GLOBAL_KEY string not shared across modules
description:
The Sieve global script key '_global' is defined as a local const in crates/smtp/src/session.rs:949:
  const GLOBAL_KEY: &str = "_global";

But the same string is also hardcoded in sieve_admin.rs:338 in the user_exists() validation function. This creates typo risk and makes it impossible for tests to import the constant.

Required fix: Define GLOBAL_KEY as a public const in a shared location (e.g. crates/smtp/src/lib.rs or a new crates/smtp/src/constants.rs), then import and use it in both session.rs and sieve_admin.rs. Update tests to import the constant rather than hardcoding the string.
